title: mris_surface_stats
description: Computes the group-wise mean and standard deviation of thickness differences at every vertex of the template surface.

mask_name.description: Set the filename for surface mask
mask_name.title: Mask Filename

out_name.description: Set the output filename (standard deviation of data)
out_name.title: Output Filename

mean.description: Set the output filename for mean
mean.title: Mean Output Filename

absmean.description: Set the output filename for absolute mean
absmean.title: Absolute Mean Output Filename

absstd.description: Set the output filename for standard deviation of absolute mean
absstd.title: Absolute Standard Deviation Output Filename

zscore.description: Set the output filename for z-score (only if first_group_size > 0)
zscore.title: Z-Score Output Filename

first_group_size.description: Specify how many subjects at the beginning belong to first group
first_group_size.title: First Group Size

debug.description: Specify which surface vertex number to debug
debug.title: Debug Vertex Number

data_files.description: List of input data files for computation
data_files.title: Input Data Files
